changeSet.author: Vidisha
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app.part_attribute ( delete_flag INTEGER DEFAULT 0, attribute_id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, attribute_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, company_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by BIGINT, created_date_time TIMESTAMPTZ(6), updated_by BIGINT, updated_date_time TIMESTAMPTZ(6), CONSTRAINT part_attribute_pkey PRIMARY KEY (attribute_id), CONSTRAINT part_attribute_company_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES app.company (company_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT part_attribute_name_key UNIQUE (attribute_name, company_id, delete_flag) );
changeSet.rollback: -- Drop the table if it exists (inverse of create table) DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app.part_attribute;
